title: Heatsheet
features: Role pick at sign in: School admin, Organiser / PE teacher, Official, Spectator, each sees only what it needs
Live event dashboard: event progress, events running now, results waiting, live house standings
Event list: sports days, house competitions, inter-school tournaments, swimming galas
Create event wizard: event type, sport, competition format (round robin, league, knockout, groups + knockout), houses, scoring
Houses, year groups, classes and teams with participant assignment
Sports day schedule: activities on stations with time slots, conflict warnings when a student is in two places at once
Automatic fixture generation for round robin and league, with manual edit
Knockout bracket with semi-finals, final and third-place match
Fast result entry for track events: lane times, auto positions and house points
Fast score entry for team matches: score steppers, win / draw / loss
Standings: house totals, medal table, league table, updated live
Public display mode: full-screen leaderboard for a projector or TV
User roles and permissions per event

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 1px top hairline border #F0DDE8, no gradient. Active tab: icon + label in accentFill #DE048A with a small accentTint pill behind the icon; inactive: text.secondary #5E4656.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Header on tab screens: screen title on the left in display style (Sniglet 32), a small event chip 'Sports Day 2026' and a round avatar on the right.
sharedComponents.houses: Four houses used as data colors only (dots, bars, chips with dark text): Falcons red #E5484D, Marlins blue #3E7BFA, Cedars green #2FA36B, Comets yellow #F5B300. Always shown with the house name, never color alone.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, 56px tall, accentFill #DE048A with white label (pressed accentPressed, disabled 40% opacity). Secondary button: pill, white with 1.5px borderStrong border, ink label. Text input: 12px radius, 52px, white, borderStrong border, focus = 2px accentFill ring, error = danger border + 13px helper. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, 32px, accentTint fill with accentFill text, 13px; selected chip = accentFill fill with white text. Live badge: small pill with a dot, danger-free (accentFill text on accentTint). Progress bar: 8px pill track surfaceAlt, fill accentFill.

type.minSize: 12px (13px chips and tags, 14px safety or legal text)
type.scaleRule: Use only the 5 declared sizes (display, title, body, label, caption).

designSystem.a11y: white labels on accentFill only; bright accent carries ink labels or large fills; house colours carry dark text only; text on gradients >= 4.5:1; tap targets >= 44pt
